panel.introduction: Ymir is a distant retrograde moon of Saturn. This triangular approximation uses published light-curve model dimensions with assumed polar caps. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Approximate triangular shape from published 20, 24 and 25 km equatorial sides and an 8 km polar semiaxis. Polar caps and the initial meridian are assumed; the original inversion mesh is unavailable.
controls.title: Triangular shape approximation

charts.alt: Cassini ISS clear-filter measurements · 2015-07-11 · Sun–moon–spacecraft angle 29°. Relative magnitude versus rotational phase, folded by the authors; smaller magnitudes are brighter. The released table has no per-point uncertainties. Sequence ISS_218OT_YMICOL029; its magnitude zero point is relative, not an absolute brightness or a surface map.
